levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: the first group's «أبي» and «جماعة مشايخي» are co-transmitters of Sa'd b. Abd Allah (rule 2); «جماعة مشايخي» is unnamed
the second isnad («حدثني محمد بن الحسن ...») carries the same saying («مثله»), so it is a second group; it is not marked variant, since it is a full route and not a remark
the Imam «أبي عبد الله» ends each route inside the chain after «عن», so narrator (owner ruling 2); the blessing is not part of the surface
